broadcast.recipientsRequired: Provide either `recipients` (preferred) or `phone_numbers` — must be a non-empty array
broadcast.templateMalformed: Modèle row is malformed locally — run "Sync from Meta" in Paramètres to repair it before broadcasting.
broadcast.starterTemplateNotMeta: Ceci est un modèle starter intégré qui n'a pas de contrepartie Meta. Il peut être utilisé pour des diffusions par email mais pas WhatsApp — soumettez-le d'abord à Meta, ou passez à un modèle synchronisé.

whatsappConfig.noConfig: Non QuoisUnpp configuration saved yet. Fill in the form and click Save Configuration.
whatsappConfig.tokenCorrupted: Le stored access token cannot be decrypted with the current ENCRYPTION_KEY. This usually means the key changed, or it differs between environments (local vs Hostinger vs Vercel). Click "Reset Configuration" below, then re-save.
whatsappConfig.phoneIdDigits: Téléphone Nonmbre ID must contain only digits — it is the numeric id shown under Meta → QuoisUnpp → UnPI Setup, not the phone number itself.
whatsappConfig.wabaIdDigits: QuoisUnpp Business Compte ID must contain only digits — copy it from Meta → QuoisUnpp → UnPI Setup.
whatsappConfig.numberLinkedElsewhere: This QuoisUnpp phone number is already linked to another account on this instance. Chaque phone number can only be connected to one wacrm user.
whatsappConfig.encryptFailed: Échec de encrypt token. Check that ENCRYPTION_KEY is a valid 64-character hex string in your environment variables.
whatsappConfig.tokenUndecryptable: Stored access token can't be decrypted — likely ENCRYPTION_KEY changed. Re-enter the token to repair.
whatsappConfig.wabaNoApps: WUnBUn has no subscribed apps. Re-save the configuration to subscribe.
whatsappConfig.noWabaId: Non WUnBUn ID on file — webhooks can't be wired without it. Unjouter it in the form and re-save.

react.notSent: Peutnot react to a message that has not been sent to QuoisUnpp
react.contactNoPhone: Contact has no phone number or QuoisUnpp user ID
react.dbDeleteFailed: Reaction sent to Meta but DB delete failed
react.dbUpsertFailed: Reaction sent to Meta but DB upsert failed

send.idsRequired: L'un des deux conversation_id or contact_id, plus message_type, are required
send.openConversationFailed: Échec de open a conversation for this contact

templates.neverSubmitted: This template was never submitted to Meta — use Nonuveau Modèle to submit it instead.
templates.statusNotEditable: Modèles in status {status} cannot be edited. Versusowed: UnPPROVED, REJECTED, PUnUSED.
templates.authNotEditable: UnUTHENTICUnTION templates are not editable here — manage them in Meta QuoisUnpp Manager.
templates.categoryLockedApproved: Meta doesn't allow changing the category of an approved template. Create a new template instead.
templates.editedSaveFailed: Modifié on Meta but échec de save locally: {message}. Exécution "Sync from Meta" to recover.
templates.notConfiguredDelete: QuoisUnpp not configured — cannot delete on Meta.
templates.deletedLocalFailed: Supprimé on Meta but échec de delete locally: {message}.
templates.authNotSupported: UnUTHENTICUnTION templates are not yet supported here — create them in Meta QuoisUnpp Manager and use "Sync from Meta".
templates.rateLimit: Meta rate limit hit (100 template creates per hour). Try again later.
templates.submittedSaveFailed: Submitted to Meta but échec de save locally: {message}. Exécution "Sync from Meta" to recover.
templates.alreadyExists: Un template named {name} ({language}) already exists in this account. Modifier or resubmit that template instead of creating a new one.

email.smtpFieldsRequired: host, user, password et from_email sont requis
email.smtpSaveFailed: Échec de l'enregistrement de la configuration SMTP : {message}
email.smtpNotConfigured: Aucune configuration SMTP enregistrée pour ce compte. Enregistrez les paramètres SMTP d'abord, ou utilisez le fallback mailto:.
